title: Vaakunan värit ja käytännön sovellukset
slide_intent: Adapt heraldic colors to production methods so a symbolic color remains recognizable when metallic effects cannot be reproduced.
strategic_value: Explicit substitutions can keep Helsinki’s coat of arms consistent between print, office documents and screens.
demonstration: Finnish prose precedes tables of one-color and four-color specifications, including Pantone, CMYK, RGB and HTML values.
practical_value: Distinguish metallic gold and silver from yellow and white substitutes in routine reproduction.

content_islands.name: Application explanation
content_islands.spec: Upper text describes digital, office and print limitations and substitutions.

content_islands.name: Color tables
content_islands.spec: Lower ruled tables align color names with production values.

reference_purposes.Application: The prose explains metallic-color substitutions; the tables give production-specific values for one-color and four-color reproduction.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The text replaces gold with yellow and silver with white in four-color versions and distinguishes metallic production from screen reproduction.
